name: action-browser
description: Skills for driving the browser_* tools served by `lattices mcp`. The MCP server itself ships with the lattices CLI.
author: Arach

interface.shortDescription: Skills for the lattices MCP browser tools
interface.longDescription: Action Browser gives agents a small browser-use surface backed by a real, isolated Chrome profile. Open a page without stealing focus, inspect its interactive elements, click or fill a field, and receive a PNG screenshot directly in the tool result. The tools are served by `lattices mcp`; this plugin carries the skill that explains how to use them.
